note: Scored by hand against sim/scenarios.mjs. 'correct' means the answer names the true cause as the primary cause. Scorer: the AI agent that also wrote the scenarios; not independently reviewed.

scores.comment: Cause has no alert. Alerts-only blamed cache-01, a symptom.
Alerts-only named the right host but not the memory leak; the investigator found the leak and the crash loop.
Investigator's cause is right (build 413 rollout) but it wrongly inferred that nodes still on 412 were failing; the version item is only sampled every 5 minutes, so it was reading stale values.
Alerts-only named both hosts but blamed db-02 (the unrelated replica) for the slowdown. The investigator separated the two faults correctly.
Investigator also listed the unrelated db-02 alert as a second low-confidence cause, while marking it unrelated.

native_note: zabbix80_window_rule: 'correct' means the true cause host is among the problems Zabbix 8.0 marked as a cause under a first-event-in-window rule (15-minute window, modelled as 45 s at 20x speed). It does not require that the symptoms were attached to it. INC-01 is 'debatable': Zabbix marked the router's link-down alert, which points at the failed link but not at dist-sw-02. In INC-07 every alert was attached to an unrelated, long-open alert on the lab's own 'Zabbix server' host.
